name: Shoujo
source:
[Spoiler]Her real name isn't Kana, she just pretends to be [url=/c93369]her[/url]. 

She used to be [url=/c23153]Hanami's[/url] classmate in an all-girls school. After the rape incident, she got kicked out and her life started to spiral. 

She decided to take revenge on Hanami, since Hanami never got punished for anything. Before that, however, she decided to "test her skills" and, together with [url=/c23154]Somari[/url], make sure that Hanami gives up [url=/c24086]Yuuki[/url].[/spoiler]
